Contract LibraryManagementSystemSystem::payOverDueFee(uid: String,fee: Real): Boolean {
	definition:
		uid: String,
		fee: Real
	precondition:
		let obs: Set(User) = User.allInstance()->select(u|u.UserID = uid) in
		obs.size()>0 and
		obs->forAll(o: User|o.OverDueFee>0)
	postcondition:
		let ob: User = User.allInstance()->any(o: User|o.UserID = uid) in
		ob.OverDueFee = ob.OverDueFee-fee and
		result = true
}
